retrievalProfile.description: A 1980s-style layout featuring a centered portrait within a white frame, set against a vibrant red border with bold, stacked typography.

recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast composition featuring a central rectangular window containing a man in a light suit standing before a split-color map of the USA, all enclosed by a thick, saturated red outer frame with heavy display type at the top.
coreVisualRelationships: Central subject framed by a white rectangular window
Subject positioned in front of a dual-tone (red/blue) map graphic
Bold typography anchored to the top of the outer red frame
Symmetrical balance between the outer border and the inner content
coreInvariants: White inner frame with thin black outline
Split-color map silhouette (red on left, blue on right)
Soft, diffused lighting on the central figure

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Full-body or three-quarter portrait centered vertically within the inner frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The bold white display text at the top center acts as the primary anchor.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the top text, move down to the subject's face, and then expand to the map and outer border.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Substantial negative space provided by the thick red border and the white background of the inner frame.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Saturated Red (Background border and left side of map)
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: White (Inner frame background and primary text)
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Royal Blue (Right side of map and secondary text)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the border and map elements contrasts with the high-key, low-contrast photography of the subject.
paletteRestrictions: Limit to Red, White, Blue, and neutral skin/suit tones.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Heavy, rounded sans-serif with geometric proportions.
characterSpecificRedesigns: Letters like 'S' and 'C' have very small apertures

composition.position: Top center of the red border
composition.relationshipToImage: Separated by a thin horizontal line

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Pair a heavy display font with a condensed, blocky sans-serif for secondary information.
graphicDevices: Silhouette map of the United States

candidateDirections.nameOrCategory: Pump Triline or similar heavy rounded sans

candidateDirections.reason: Suitable for the secondary condensed text

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a solid red background with a centered white rectangular window. Inside the window, place a man in a light-colored 80s suit standing in front of a red and blue split-color map of the USA.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add bold, white, rounded geometric sans-serif text at the top center. Place a thin horizontal line above and below the secondary text line.

verificationChecks: Is the outer border a solid, vibrant red?
Is the subject centered within a white frame?
Is the map behind the subject split into red and blue halves?
Is the typography bold and rounded?

mustRedesign: Do not use existing brand logos
Ensure map silhouette is a generic geographical shape

mustAchieve: Clean, sharp edges on the frame
High color saturation in the red border

postGenerationChecks: Check for the thin black outline around the white inner frame
Ensure the text is perfectly centered
Verify the 80s soft-focus quality of the photography
Confirm the map colors align with the patriotic theme
recipe.reuseFormula: Saturated Border + Framed Portrait + Split-Tone Graphic + Heavy Geometric Type
